findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Inspector observed at least 8 dented cans in the facility. PIC was informed that cans that are dented on the top, bottom, or side seams or cans that are dented such that the dents come to a pointed edge pose the risk of botulism growth and food-borne illness transmission. The PIC will remove the dented cans when time allows, for he is the only employee currently present at the facility.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Observed single use plates in boxes stored on the floor. Also, a box of aluminum pans is observed on the floor open and for sale. The items were moved up off of the floor. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The following were observed to be soiled:
A) Coke cooler - bottom inside and tracks (debris/splash);
B) milk/dairy cooler shelving (mold/splash on left and middle sections);   and
C) small Pepsi cooler by front door (buildup/debris - shelving and bottom inside).

Clean general surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - Floor was soiled with dust/debris/grocery items under the milk and dairy cooler, freezer, and shelving in the food storage area of the store.
Clean the floors throughout under shelving and cold holding equipment as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

Floors shall be maintained clean.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.citation_text:
750.1230(b)(2) - Lights in freezer were not working. Inspector had to use a flashlight to see in the bottom of the freezer. Shift manager stated a work order was placed ~2-3 weeks ago. Manager was advised to check on the status of work order.

Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide, at a distance of 30 inches from the floor at least 10 foot-candles of light in walk-in refrigeration, dry storage areas, and in all other areas.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.citation_text:
750.1390 - Wet mop was stored in the mopsink. Store mops hanging or inverted to allow for proper drying of wet mop heads, which can serve as a food/water source for pests.

Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored properly.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) bottom inside cooler by fruit punch (dried milk splash) & B) bottom inside and tracks of Coke cooler (dead bugs/debris). Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - Floor was soiled with crumbs, wrappers, and debris under shelves on sales floor used for food storage. Clean the floors throughout under shelving as needed to eliminate a buildup of debris.
Floors shall be maintained clean.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: Raw frozen hamburger stored above other ready to eat foods in the 2 dr freezer. Store raw below ready to eat or other foods that would be cooked to a lower temperature-cross contamination. Sectoion 750.130d

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment: Back door used for receiving product with gap at the bottom. Section 750.1170 Seal the back door gap.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Observed a box of rees's candy stored on the floor in storeroom. Food shall be stored a minimum of 6" above the floor. Store food properly.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Edges of shelves in restrooms are not properly sealed.
